page_title: DOR 3-2 PAU | Dortmund v St. Pauli 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Gregor Kobel comfortably gathers the ball.
90+8' The corner kick from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+6' 3 - 2 Goal! Nikola Vasilj gets a hand on the penalty from Emre Can (Dortmund), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
90+5' Emre Can (Dortmund) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' There's a break in play and referee Harm Osmers must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Dortmund using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+3' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Harm Osmers blows for a foul. Dortmund are awarded a free kick.
90+2' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

90+1' Emre Can (Dortmund) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 62:38.
84' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
83' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Julian Brandt and he is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
83' Substitution. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) on for Felix Nmecha.
83' Flag up against Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
82' Gregor Kobel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Eric Smith (St. Pauli).
82' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now St. Pauli have a corner.
81' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli).
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.

78' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Gregor Kobel makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
78' The attendance is 81365.

78' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
76' A brilliant cross into the box finds Joel Fujita (St. Pauli), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
76' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) sends a long cross over to Daniel Svensson, but Nikola Vasilj comes forward to gather the ball.
72' 2 - 2 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Eric Smith and Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) gets in a shot, sending the ball into the top of the net. 2:2.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Ryerson departs the field of play to be replaced by Yan Couto (Dortmund).
71' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Fabio Silva will be replaced by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) will replace Karim Adeyemi.
69' Harm Osmers shows the yellow card to Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) for a heavy challenge.
67' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
66' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for St. Pauli.
64' Here comes a substitution. Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Martijn Kaars.
64' Here is a change. Lars Ritzka is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Louis Oppie (St. Pauli).
64' Adam Dzwigala comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli).
62' 2 - 1 James Sands (St. Pauli) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
62' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
61' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and St. Pauli will take a corner.
58' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
56' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) launches a cross from the corner, but Nikola Vasilj is alert to thwart the effort.
54' 2 - 0 Goal! Fabio Silva manages to prod the ball to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
54' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) tries to find Karim Adeyemi, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
53' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Daniel Svensson, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
52' Great teamplay by Dortmund as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
48' The free kick into the penalty area from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cleared.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Harm Osmers has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Karim Adeyemi finds Julian Brandt (Dortmund) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
45+1' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
43' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Harm Osmers ignores the protests.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) heads on.
39' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
38' The ball is out of play. Dortmund win a corner kick.
38' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Eric Smith (St. Pauli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
38' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.
34' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
33' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
30' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Gregor Kobel leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.

26' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
25' James Sands (St. Pauli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Dortmund.

22' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
20' Emre Can (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Harm Osmers interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
19' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The St. Pauli players are visibly unhappy with the call.
19' Referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for St. Pauli. Let’s see what happens!
18' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
16' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Today's referee Harm Osmers rightly decides to book Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) for his harsh tackle.

13' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
13' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but Nikola Vasilj punches the ball away.
12' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to St. Pauli.
7' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) attempts to find Mathias Pereira Lage, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
6' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
4' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) sends a long ball forward to Daniel Svensson, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
2' Emre Can (Dortmund) plays a long ball to Karim Adeyemi, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
1' The match has just started.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
Harm Osmers will supervise the game today.
